specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D RPG VFX sprite sheet, ultra crisp painterly animation, transparent RGBA background. EXACT evenly spaced 4 columns by 3 rows = 12 equal square animation cells, 1536x1152 canvas, no cell outlines, no text, no labels, no background, generous fully transparent 12% margin inside EVERY cell, nothing crosses a cell boundary. Chronological left-to-right then top-to-bottom. The shapes and material breakup must actually evolve across every cell; do not repeat static icons. Palette: incandescent ivory-gold core, solid antique-gold structure, crimson red accents, restrained warm embers. Strong legible silhouettes and substantial opaque cores survive small-size display. NO birds, phoenix, wings, feathers, animals, creatures, summoning circles, runes, characters, hands, weapons other than arrows. Alpha transparency must be real; no checkerboard painted into pixels. Asset: disciplined 7-arrow fan volley burst animation. Seven long straight golden arrows launch together to the right in a narrow spreading fan, distinct ivory arrowheads and crimson metal insets. All7 tips stay near x=75-80% and fan between y=28-72%; arrow tails remain x=22-40%. Twelve stages: 1-3 the seven individual arrows solidify from stretched lines; 4-6 surge with dense speed streaks; 7-9 arrows separate with splitting air sheets; 10-12 the long streaks fragment to angular sparks. Side view, not overhead. Keep all pixels safely inside the cell, at least20% blank gutters. Clear straight shafts, sharp tips, no feathers and absolutely no wings. This is a tightly disciplined volley with visible negative spaces between each arrow, not a blob.
